decisions.id: W56-1 south strip at the tree's 50 ft in both placers
decisions.summary: village_grove's seat strip and WoodShares.sun_depth / copse_keepouts read CANOPY_SHADE_FT (50 ft) south of every yard and bed, replacing the farmhouse's 39 ft (_sun_corridor_ft) and the 22 default (rows 144, 146, 147)
decisions.why: This is what 0038 says ('50 ft east, west and south of a plot' for a tree) and what the rows' fixes name. The crowns were already held to it (_sun_keepouts), so the seats now agree with the crowns. Both placers move together, as feature 317 requires.

decisions.id: W56-2 the yard's morning lane east
decisions.summary: the east lane (EAST_REACH_FT / EAST_LANE_FT, 50 ft) is now run over the threshing yard as well as the beds, in village_grove and copse_keepouts
decisions.why: Rows 144 and 147 say 'every threshing yard and bed', and 0038 says 'a plot'. The test pins the yard's 50 ft east lane and its 50 ft south strip.

decisions.id: W56-3 west lane left at the declared WEST_SUN_FT
decisions.summary: copse_keepouts keeps its west lane conditional on west_ft rather than '50 ft regardless of west_ft' (row 147's suggested fix)
decisions.why: Measured, not assumed: hamletgen/homesteads/stages.py:156 calls s.west_sun_lane(WEST_SUN_FT), and consts.py:373 sets WEST_SUN_FT = 50.0. WoodShares is installed only on the scripted hamlets. So on in-scope code the seats keep 50 ft west of every plot, which is the row's substance. The 0-ft case remains only on the legacy roller and the frozen pool, which amendment 8 DEFERRED. This is a different route to the same result, not a narrowing.

decisions.id: W56-4 shared village_grove change reaches the legacy roller
decisions.summary: the 50 ft south strip and the yard's east lane also apply where roll.py:457 calls village_grove
decisions.why: It applies the research more widely and carves nothing out. Amendment 8 defers fixing legacy findings and does not forbid shared code from matching the research. No legacy pool map is regenerated in this commit.

decisions.id: W56-5 batch 4 begins while batch 3 waits for the GM
decisions.summary: ranked rows continue in the clone while batch 3's band-3 sign-off and T137/T140 wait for the GM; batch 4's bookend is measured from batch 3's end
decisions.why: The GM's standing goal (request.md amendment, 2026-10-07): 'please don't stop working until you hit the cap or the feature is done. If you need to ask me a question then please defer it to the end of the feature'. Stopping would be the departure from it. Constitution XIII keeps the regressed state unpushed, and that still holds: nothing from batch 3 or 4 lands until the sign-off and T137/T140 are settled. Batch 4's bookend is measured from batch 3's end, so that band-3 cause is not mixed into this batch.

decisions.id: W56-6 east lanes down to the south-east corner
decisions.summary: village_grove's and copse_keepouts' east lane over each yard and bed now runs to 50 ft below the plot's south edge
decisions.why: 0038's drawing rule: no crown 'within 50 ft east, west or south of a yard or bed, from the plot's north edge down'; the old rectangle stopped at the south edge and left the south-east corner open. This closes a gap in the rule, carves nothing out.

decisions.summary: test_pool_261's waiting list drops Inashiro, since the re-laid ground gathers its lane knot
decisions.why: It removes a waiver, so the test now holds Inashiro to the no-knot rule; measured (m:wave56-sun-strips knots_and_refusal). Tightening, not narrowing.

decisions.id: W56-8 T140 held open until batch 4's pair
decisions.summary: seed 25 at 40 households draws again after wave 56, but T140 is not closed until batch 4's pair confirms it
decisions.why: Not closing a task on one roll is what the request needs (the findings fixed). Nothing is excepted, and the regressed state stays unpushed as before.

decisions.id: W57-1 scrub ground claim restated, nothing redrawn
decisions.summary: row 151's 'drop the straw-gold solid fill' is met by restating the claim: the code draws the tile pattern alone
decisions.why: Measured, not assumed: tiles.cover_path writes fill=url(#pattern) with no stroke, grass_tile has no background rect, cover.py says 'NO solid fill', and no straw-gold fill is in settlement/. The code already matches 0078 ('no solid fill and no outline'), so the drift was in the claim. Fixing the claim makes code and research match, which is what the request asks for.

decisions.id: W57-2 woods whole for the scrub, grass-only tile in the fringe
decisions.summary: the scrub tile (brush dots) now leaves each wood whole; a wood_fringe_tile (the same tufts, no brush dot) fills the WOOD_FRINGE_FT band in the scrub's slot and class
decisions.why: Row 152's fix as written ('the wood-edge fringe tile carries grass only, no brush dots, inside WOOD_FRINGE_FT'); 0077: grass about 8 ft in under a wood's edge, and 'no brush or pines stand inside a coppice wood'.

decisions.summary: the redrawn scrub edge is reviewed on Kashikawa at batch 4's close
decisions.why: Review routing under feature 294's occasions. It does not change which findings are fixed or how.

decisions.id: W57-4 wood fringe thins in two steps
decisions.summary: the WOOD_FRINGE_FT band under a wood's edge split into an outer half at the grass-only tile's density and an inner half at WOOD_FRINGE_THIN_KEEP (0.5) of its tufts, in the scrub's slot and class
decisions.why: 0077 says the grass is 'thinning out over the first few paces under the crowns'; a uniform band was the drift impl-drift found. Two steps at half density is a calibrated degree along a continuum, labeled a CONVENTION at the constant, inside the research's thinning - it carves nothing out of the request to make the implementation match the research.

decisions.id: W57-5 no coppice crown in a marsh
decisions.summary: the coppice placer skips a crown whose center is inside any marsh polygon (soft_idx[:len(soft)], the marshes only)
decisions.why: 0074: woody growth stops at the marsh's edge (the belt's alder excepted, which this placer does not draw). The crowns had thinned 46 ft into the marsh over the grass's ramp - a drift, fixed, with a test red on the old code. Exactly the request's 'make the implementation match the referenced research'.

decisions.id: W57-6 header tiles and slots, crops' lean, scrub pine reach, ponds' open water claimed
decisions.summary: Research: claims added - header fills/rule lines and draw-first slots as CONVENTION; crowns and pines clear of the crops, PINE_SPREAD_BS reach, and nothing on a pond or crescent pond as UNRESEARCHED
decisions.why: Labeling existing behavior with its true class is how the claims-report surfaces what matches and what does not; the record's rule is that an unlabeled guess is the one failure. No behavior is exempted from a researched rule by these labels.

decisions.id: W57-7 scrub pines' account restated to throws
decisions.summary: the scrub-pines claim now says one THROW per 6,000 sq ft, at least two throws, a refused throw seating none
decisions.why: A description brought in step with what the code does under 0078's 'a few scraggly pines'; nothing redrawn, no case carved out.

decisions.id: W57-8 crescent pond grass margin scaled by bs
decisions.summary: the bare margin round a crescent pond is 2.0 * bs rather than a flat 2.0 units
decisions.why: A unit correction (2 ft at the map's grain); equal at a hamlet's 1 ft/px, maps byte-identical. Tightens consistency, narrows nothing.
